name: St. Pantaleon
bio:
Pantaleon was a physician of Nicomedia in Asia Minor who lived in the late third century. The son of a wealthy pagan father and a Christian mother, he was converted to Christianity by the priest Hermolaus and devoted his medical skill to serving the poor without charge.

During the persecution of the emperor Diocletian, he was denounced as a Christian, arrested, and subjected to tortures from which, according to tradition, he was repeatedly delivered by miracles. He was finally beheaded around 305.

Pantaleon is one of the Fourteen Holy Helpers and is counted among the great martyr physicians of the early Church. He is invoked by physicians and by the sick, and his intercession is sought for healing of all kinds.

prayer.text: St. Pantaleon, physician who healed the poor without charge and died for the faith, pray for doctors and for all who are ill, that healing may come to body and soul. Amen.
